name: CrabS3
description: Transfer platform for S3-compatible storage. Send large files and encrypted secrets from your own S3 bucket - resumable multipart uploads, download limits, auto-deletion, 2FA and ClamAV scanning. No cloud. No bill. Just S3 buckets full of crabs. 🦀

notes.text: Signup is invite-only by design. The installer seeds one admin account and prints its email/password once during install - save them, they are not stored anywhere and not shown again.
Changing JWT_SECRET after install invalidates every session and every share-link signature.

Requires an existing S3-compatible bucket (RustFS, MinIO, AWS S3, Wasabi, Ceph, OVH...). Credentials can be supplied at install time or added later to /opt/crabs3/.env, followed by 'systemctl restart crabs3'.
ClamAV downloads its virus-signature database during install; on a slow connection this can take a few minutes. Uploads are not scanned until it completes.
